cases.summary: The NUL-like child-readable stdin behavior is accepted because the parent has no stdin handle and no data entered during the diagnostic; explicit Core closure remains a later hardening item.
Native containment and interactive terminal are deferred; real local Runner remains fail-closed and unavailable.
evidence: docs/DECISIONS.md#adr-0055-win7-mvp-负责人接受延期边界与桌面装配启动

cases.summary: SQLite persistence, FTS5 and crash recovery are deferred; the MVP uses bounded in-memory state and makes no persistence or mechanical-disk performance claim.
Visual focus, controlled reboot and strict clean-OS checks are deferred; isolated deployment and userData evidence is accepted for the MVP.
Application-layer denial is accepted for the MVP while the SSH management channel remains intact; physical disconnection and packet capture are deferred.
Existing CPython and probe evidence is sufficient for the MVP; architect-only frozen-contract gates remain formal-release work.
Enterprise proxy, CA, model and update services are deferred; the MVP shell exposes the Gateway as unconfigured or Replay and does not claim E7.

notes: OWNER_ACCEPTED_FOR_MVP is not a formal PASS and does not modify accepted Phase or SPIKE contracts.
Any deferred capability must recover its original Gate before becoming a production default.
The MVP can install by copying to an isolated directory, start, render diagnostics and exit; it cannot yet execute real local commands or recover persistent sessions.
